executivePulse.interpretation: Memory and AI infrastructure remain under strain. Server DRAM / RDIMM, HBM and enterprise SSDs are currently among the tightest segments. The Daily Check on 2026-08-20 reviewed eight relevant reports; there is currently no confirmed material directional change. New capacity and improved yields can relieve pressure but will reach the market only with a time lag. For buyers, supply assurance, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
